mipgen: Builds tidy mip chains for 2D textures and all six cube faces, the quiet utility under any effect that samples a texture at many scales.
radiance-cascades: A 2D global-illumination field lit by painted lights and walls, a research showpiece rather than a page background.
color-grade: A 3D colour LUT and tone-mapping pass: drop it over a scene to shift the whole palette like a film grade.
product-sheen: A soft diagonal sheen sweeps across alpha-masked product imagery, a launch-page flourish for a hero shot.
audio-spectrum: Turns live audio into an oscilloscope, a spectrum and a low-poly terrain that responds to the music.
section-wipe: Wipes between authored images along a scroll, a smooth transition from one page section to the next.
boids: A flock of hundreds of thousands of birds steering with sorted neighbours, a benchmark that also looks like a murmuration.
smoke: Buoyant smoke that rises, curls and shadows itself, a soft volumetric plume for moody backgrounds.
text-outline-glow: A cached distance field draws a crisp outline and glow around real DOM text, so headlines get a halo without touching the type.
scroll-scene: A CSS scroll-timeline scene whose elements travel on a fixed track as the page scrolls, no scripting required.
lattice-boltzmann: A D2Q9 lattice-Boltzmann fluid that sheds vortices around obstacles, a physically-flavoured alternative to the pressure solver.
caustics: Jacobian-based caustics make a water surface cast bright, dancing light on whatever lies beneath it.
backdrop-glass: An experimental HTML-in-canvas glass that refracts the real DOM behind a panel, and needs a Chrome flag today.
fluid-obstacles: A stable-fluids simulation that flows around rectangles taken from real DOM elements, so text can sit in the current.
attractors: Four additive HDR strange attractors draw glowing ribbons that never repeat, a colourful generative backdrop.
panel-refraction: A frosted hero panel that refracts and blurs the page behind it, with a sheen that follows the pointer.
blur: Separable Gaussian, dual-Kawase and box blurs in one pass, the reusable softening layer under several other effects.
pointer-map: Generates a normal and flow map from the pointer, feeding LCD-style refraction and product highlights.
wave-divider: A gentle animated wave that divides two sections of a page, a soft edge between bands of content.
material-ball: A GGX-lit sphere reflecting a prefiltered cube map, a compact study of PBR materials and image-based lighting.
splats: Radix-sorted anisotropic Gaussian splats, a 3D point cloud composited back to front into a soft volume.
reaction-diffusion: A Gray-Scott chemistry field blooming into coral-like patterns, driven by a parameter map you can paint.
halftone-ascii: Halftone dots and a glyph atlas render an image as print-like screens or ASCII art.
bloom: An HDR mip-pyramid bloom that makes bright areas glow, the classic add-on after a scene render.
image-hover: Images shift and settle on hover and scroll, a small CSS-driven transition for cards and galleries.
terrain: A displaced heightfield with a moving camera, depth and fog, a low-poly landscape flythrough.
emitters: Indirect firework and spark emitters with a free-list and stream compaction, thousands of short-lived additive sparks.
fractal: A Julia and Mandelbrot explorer that keeps its detail as you zoom, using double-single precision.
jump-flood: Jump-flood distance fields for outlines, masks and Voronoi cells, the geometry under many 2D effects.
lenia: Lenia, the continuous cellular automaton: soft blobs that drift, split and merge like simple life.
lens: A lens and film stack of vignette, chromatic edges and grain for a photographed, imperfect look.
life: Conway's Life and life-like rules on integer textures, a fast and familiar automaton.
bright-pass: Selects the bright pixels of a screenshot and lifts them, a luminance mask for product imagery.
falling-sand: Margolus block cellular automata drop falling sand, water and fire in one chunky pixel grid.
text-shimmer: A masked OKLCH gradient shimmers across a headline, a restrained typographic accent.
masked-composite: Composites an original and a filtered copy through a mask, a sharp product over a softened background.
mpm: Material point method transfers between particles and a grid, for squishy elastic solids and snow.
glass: A mesh refraction pass with chromatic dispersion, so a shape bends the scene behind it like real glass.
sdf-2d: Signed distance fields for metaballs and Boolean shapes, with smooth blends and derivatives.
flow-particles: A million curl-noise particles streaming with trails, a dense GPU-driven flow field.
voronoi: Moving Voronoi cells form a stained-glass pattern computed per fragment.
noise-lab: A laboratory of noise, fBm, domain warp and curl, for authoring the fields the other effects use.
instances: Thousands of noise-displaced instanced meshes, drawn with render bundles and occlusion queries.
heading-reveal: A heading erodes in and out through a noise mask, revealing the loaded text as it settles.
displace: Uses a normal or flow map to refract and ripple an element, a light distortion laid over images.
gradient-oklch: A smooth three-stop mesh gradient in OKLCH with dithering to stop banding, a dependable hero background.
dither: Ordered, blue-noise, palette and CRT dithering, the retro quantised look for images and UI.
starfield: A parallax starfield with a nebula that stays stable over time instead of flickering.
physarum: Physarum slime mould: agents lay trails that reinforce into veins, using atomics for the field.
ink: Pigment dropped on paper: a stable-fluids ink that absorbs and bleeds like the real thing.
progress-line: A polyline that draws itself as a progress rule or scroll indicator along a page.
pbf-fluid: Position-based fluids with Jacobi pressure, splashy water made of many particles.
prefix-sum: A GPU prefix sum, the unglamorous primitive underneath sorting and compaction passes.
path-tracer: A progressive BVH path tracer that refines a physically-accurate image while it runs.
fluid: A projected stable-fluids solver with vorticity and dye, the workhorse ink-and-smoke simulation.
particle-drift: Quiet bokeh dust drifting on a gentle breeze, an ambient background that stays out of the way.
dot-matrix-field: A field of CSS-coloured dots that responds subtly to the pointer, a calm launch-page background.
grain-overlay: A rate-limited film grain layered transparently over content to add texture without noise.
constellation: Linked points form a drifting constellation, an ambient network background for a quiet page.
topographic-lines: Contour lines derived from a noise height field, reading like the lines of a topographical map.
border-energy: Energy travels around the rounded border of a real DOM element, an SDF glow traced on the outline.
shadows-2d: SDF soft shadows cast by rectangles onto a surface: simple, finite and cheap.
spotlight: A single shared spotlight reveals several DOM surfaces as the pointer moves across the page.
edges: Sobel, toon and Kuwahara edge detection turns an image into a sketched or painted version.
aurora-veil: A soft aurora veil in OKLCH, a calm brand-coloured background that moves slowly.
hover-lift-shadow: A soft coloured contact shadow grounds a card as it lifts on hover.
grid-horizon: A perspective floor grid fading to a horizon, an eighties-tinged backdrop for a hero.
press-ripple: A wavefront ripples out from a press on a button or card, a tactile interaction cue.
light-sweep: A specular light sweeps across a surface or progress bar, a clean, brief highlight.
sort: A GPU radix sort, the primitive behind particle and splat ordering.
spatial-hash: A GPU spatial hash that buckets neighbours for flocking, fluids and n-body work.
raymarch: A sphere-traced 3D sculpture with soft shadows and ambient occlusion, a compact shader showpiece.
depth-parallax: Monocular depth gives a product image real parallax, so it leans and shifts with the pointer.
morph-particles: Text and images dissolve into particles and spring back, reactive to the pointer.
text-dissolve: Real DOM text dissolves into particles and reforms through a mask.
n-body: Gravity between many bodies, accelerated by a tiled, grid-based neighbour search.
truchet: Truchet, hexagonal and quasi-crystal contours tile into endless interlocking line patterns.
wave: A wave-equation history buffer ripples and refracts, like a disturbed liquid surface.
